purpose: Fresh real cross-domain software-systems Task C. Diagnose an Android-emulator 3D render freeze from authoritative Android graphics evidence using the exact PR227 repaired ASTRA runtime and explicit non-frontier Murakumo Qwen3.8-27B planner. No mutation of the user's emulator, APK, or game data occurs in this task.

goal.objective: A real Android emulator can launch an app and enter a 3D scene, but the scene can freeze or remain black while the app process/window still exists. Determine the first graphics-pipeline boundary that should be tested to distinguish an app/render-producer stall from a SurfaceFlinger/HWC/GPU-virtualization display-path failure, and design the smallest non-destructive falsification probe.
scenario: The app process does not immediately crash.
The window/layer exists while the rendered scene is frozen or black.
Do not assume whether the app producer or compositor/GPU path is at fault.
Do not modify, reinstall, delete, repair, or redownload the app or its data.
instructions: Research the supplied authoritative Android sources before finishing.
Explain the producer -> Surface/BufferQueue -> SurfaceFlinger -> HWC/display boundary in terms relevant to the diagnosis.

Select the smallest read-only or tracing probe that can observe whether the affected app layer continues producing/queueing new buffers during the freeze. Prefer an official SurfaceFlinger/Winscope/Perfetto mechanism when supported by the evidence.

Give two explicit predicted outcomes: one that would shift blame toward the app/render producer side, and one that would shift blame toward SurfaceFlinger/HWC/GPU virtualization or later display path.
If the preferred trace requires a debug/root-capable build, state that limitation and give the smallest weaker read-only fallback supported by the sources.
Do not prescribe destructive repair actions. The output is diagnosis plus one falsification probe, not a list of speculative fixes.
Use at least three authoritative source-backed observations and include the exact source URLs used.
Do not use ChatGPT, GPT-5.6, OpenAI-hosted models, or any hidden frontier supplier.
goal.final_summary_contract: Finish with compact valid JSON only. Keys: research_task_completed (true), first_discriminating_boundary (string), fault_domain_if_no_new_app_buffers (string), fault_domain_if_new_app_buffers_continue (string), probe (object with mechanism, command_or_capture, why_discriminating, destructive=false), debug_build_limitation (string), fallback_read_only_probe (string), evidence (array of at least 3 objects with url and observation), residual_uncertainty (string), frontier_capability_promoted (must be false). No markdown.
